purpose: Characterize the raw derivative-difference observer under the actual retry semantic of shortening one attempt from the same committed state, and determine whether its finite-reference relation approaches a predictable asymptotic regime before the known fine-step solver cliff.

matrix.smallest_reference_substep_relation_to_k: 2x the first previously observed failed direct solve dt

per_attempt_observables.hdot_n: right-sided semi-discrete bootstrap recomputed from the same committed h0 under the new bottom head
per_attempt_observables.bottom_effective_stiffness: XEFF=hdot_n(bottom)/hdot_np1(bottom)-1 only when both derivatives have the same nonzero sign and the ratio is >=1
per_attempt_observables.scalar_linear_R8_prediction: 0.5*x^2/(1+x) divided by abs(1/(1+x)-(1+x/8)^(-8)) when XEFF is available and positive

analytic_context_not_acceptance_rule.reason: For a first-order backward-Euler step compared with an eight-substep backward-Euler endpoint, the leading-order difference is 7/8 of the first-step local error while e_h has the full leading coefficient.
analytic_context_not_acceptance_rule.use: context for observed approach only; nonlinear B1.10 data are not required to hit this value

predeclared_interpretation.EOBS_lt_E1_8: negative transfer evidence at that transaction-local retry level
predeclared_interpretation.EOBS_ge_E1_8: finite-reference-consistent relation only, not a true-error proof
predeclared_interpretation.R8_decreases_toward_order_one_with_halvi: supports the hypothesis that C2 overconservatism is a large-dt stiffness effect rather than an irreducible state-dependent scale defect
predeclared_interpretation.R8_remains_large_or_nonmonotone: supports a separate stiffness-aware estimator/normalization research gate before any production candidate
predeclared_interpretation.XEFF_linear_prediction_tracks_R8: supports, but does not qualify, a source-bound stiffness-aware correction hypothesis

harness_pass_rules: All 15 cases complete all 10 retry-sized attempt intervals for N1, N4 and N8, or any failure is preserved and attributed without changing the frozen matrix.
Every completed substep passes the unchanged 1e-12 external hard mass gate.
EOBS, E1_8 and D4_8 are finite and nonnegative.
O0 and O2 machine-readable outputs are identical.
Production Richards/runtime source remains identical to the F-VQ29 base.
explicitly_not_harness_pass_rules: a production retry count is acceptable
next_if_asymptotic_approach_is_clean: Freeze an owner candidate profile that defines the raw observer validity envelope and required transaction-local history/bootstrap semantics, then design a separate held-out F-VQ workunit. If the approach is not clean, open a separate stiffness-aware observer research gate instead of fitting a global factor.
